signals.name: Steering angle
signals.description: Positive is rotated to the left, negative is rotated to the right.

signals.name: Target speed, raw
signals.description: Signed 16-bit value from the cruise control module. Replies do not read as the speed of the vehicle ahead: a truck doing 3 km/h reads the equivalent of -61 km/h.

signals.name: Manifold pressure sensor voltage
signals.description: Typically varies from 1 volt at idle to 5 volts during wide open throttle.

signals.name: Fuel pump duty cycle, low pressure
Lambda, commanded
signals.description: The ratio of oxygen in the combustion chamber compared to the amount that should have been present for ideal combustion.

signals.name: Fuel rail sensor voltage, high pressure
